justification: The three declared hazards (1,3), (1,4) and (3,3) sit in the middle of the left room, and none of them lies on THIS route: up column 1 to press the button, back down column 1, right along rows 5 and 6 to the door, through the teleport and up column 6. That route is 18 commands, it avoids all three cells, and exhibiting it settles the question -- a surviving route is a proof of solvability all by itself. Note what is deliberately NOT claimed: the hazards are not off *every* minimal route. (3,3) lies on 72 of the atrium's 204 shortest winning sequences, and 132 of them avoid all three cells.
notes: The near-twin of the cistern cut: same operator, cells that do not cut.
